description: This PHP file defines the TextTranslator class within the Goteo\Library\Translator namespace. The class manages translation data, including fetching catalogs, handling translations, and interfacing with a database for translation text entries. It implements translation-related functionalities such as retrieving translations, checking pending states, and managing translation records.

classes.name: TextTranslator
classes.description: A class for handling translation texts, managing translations, pending translations, and interfacing with the database for storing and retrieving translation entries.

methods.name: getAllCatalogue
methods.description: Fetches and caches all translation catalogues from language sources and database.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used for filtering or selecting translation entries.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns ordering criteria for translation listings, empty in this implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextTranslator for a specific translation ID.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of translation entries filtered by criteria such as pending status, with pagination support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a TextTranslator instance with specified translation ID, loading relevant translation data.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Returns the translation for a specific language, respecting original language preference if specified.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of translation, which is 'plain' in this case.

methods.name: isOriginal
methods.description: Checks if a given language is the original language.

methods.name: isTranslated
methods.description: Checks if a translation exists for a given language.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if a translation for a language is pending.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a translation for a specific language if it exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a translation for a given language.
